title: A Preliminary Study of ChatGPT on News Recommendation: Personalization, Provider Fairness, Fake News

bias_targets.methodology: Dividing news organizations into popular and unpopular groups and evaluating the proportion of popular providers among ChatGPT's top-k recommendations using the precision@k metric. The study also tests various prompt formats that explicitly specify the number or priority of popular versus unpopular providers to mitigate this bias.
